outcome_summary: Built a complete integration test suite for the orchestrator's Deep Agent execution path across 6 work packages. The approach established test infrastructure (ToolCallableFakeChatModel, mock tool helpers, conftest config stubs) then layered smoke, middleware, guard/rollback, and live API tests into a single test file. The result is 8 new tests (6 @deepagent, 2 @live) in test_deep_agent_integration.py with a full test suite regression of 1099 passed / 0 failed, completing in < 2 s without API keys.
